writing-skill.note: Quiet, controlled, believable dialogue; bunk bed is apt. Low stakes, ending slightly neat, drifts toward familiar beats.

storyscope.note: Voicey, funny, very particular Australian texture; undercuts the letters trope; mysterious payer gives an open, haunting ending.

baseline.note: Repair tags are a strong conceit, but simile clusters, staged epiphany and tidy grease-to-the-wrist reconciliation feel manufactured.

merged.note: Ledger gives real conflict; MISC/GOOD is lovely; unresolved ending earns it. Brand-name density sometimes feels deployed.
